name: SubTandem
description: Translates the selected local embedded text subtitle or external SRT/ASS subtitle and renders translated subtitles itself in IINA.

permissionDescriptions.network-request: Connect to the bundled loopback helper. Configured or edited endpoints may receive subtitle-free model-list requests; only the selected profile receives subtitle text for translation.
permissionDescriptions.file-system: Read only the selected text subtitle from the current local media or external subtitle, store optional provider keys in a plugin-private local file, and remove temporary extracted source subtitle data when the session ends. Remote and graphic embedded subtitles are not read.
permissionDescriptions.show-alert: Confirm permanent deletion of a translation profile and its saved credential.
permissionDescriptions.video-overlay: Display the current translated subtitle in a local non-interactive translation overlay.
